units: <cite ref="Sanhedrin 39b:7">Snh. 39ᵇ</cite> (play on <he>והזנות</he>, <cite ref="I Kings 22:38">I Kings XXII, 38</cite>) <he>כדי למרק שתי ח׳</he> Ms. M. (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l.) in order to polish (make clear) two visions.
<cite ref="I Kings 22:38">Ib.</cite> (play on <he>לתמו</he>, ib. 34) <he>כדי לתמם שתי ח׳</he> to fulfill two visions.

Gen. R. s. 13; Yalk. ib. 20 (ref. to חָזִיז, q. v.) שעושה ח׳ ברקיע וכ׳ He creates (awe-inspiring) sights in the sky and causes holy inspiration to rest &c. [Ar. s. v. אד: חֲזִיזִיּוֹת, fr. חֲזיזִית, breaks, splits.]
